content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose two changes before signing.

- The relevant clause regarding payment terms currently allows 90 days after final acceptance, but the standard term is 30 days. I propose the agreement be modified to require payment within thirty (30) days after Client's final acceptance of the complete Software.
- The relevant clause assigns full ownership upon delivery of each milestone. I propose modifying this so that Developer assigns all right, title, and interest upon receipt of full payment of the Total Fixed Price.
